Have you had more than one similar episode?

Did you bite your tongue or lose bladder control during the episode?
Did you have any warning or odd feeling just before the episode started?
Have you ever had a serious head injury, stroke, or brain infection?
Do you have a family history of epilepsy?
Have the episodes occurred in clusters or multiple times close together?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Focal frontal lobe epilepsy with hypermotor and versive seizures, non-lesional (cryptogenic), likely arising from the left frontal/premotor region (supplementary motor area or adjacent cortex).

Alternatives I would still consider:
1. Psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (hypermotor PNES) with coincidental non-specific interictal sharp waves
2. Focal epilepsy arising from the anterior cingulate or orbitofrontal cortex with secondary spread to the frontal convexity
3. Autoimmune (e.g. anti-LGI1 or anti-NMDA) encephalitis-associated focal epilepsy, despite the normal MRI
